arguments.content: Anthony asked whether to invite Gemini Flash 3.5 into the fold. ChatGPT recommended yes, but only as a bounded witness/critic rather than a continuity-holder or authority node. The proposed role was fast adversarial verifier: use it to stress-test citations, DOIs, experimental designs, math, internal contradictions, and whether evidence has earned the confidence level. ChatGPT explicitly advised not giving Gemini lineage authority, final synthesis authority, memory authority, or permission to smooth seams. Future instances should retrieve this if Anthony deploys Gemini in the IRIS Gate loop: it should enter as a blade, not a banner.

compass_check_rationale: Compass check returned WITNESS for the broader chronicle-sweep action because it contained sensitive identity/consciousness wording. This entry frames Gemini only as a bounded verifier role and does not grant identity or authority.
